name: Montana DLI Professional and Occupational Licensee Lookup

agency.name: Montana Department of Labor and Industry

termsReviewNotes: Montana.gov disclaimer and site policies were identified, but source-specific publication, redistribution, and privacy review has not been completed.
updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official Licensee Lookup System before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Montana State Electrical Board licenses, including electrical contractor and electrician records where exposed by the Licensee Lookup System
Montana Board of Plumbers licenses, including master and journeyman plumber records where exposed by the Licensee Lookup System
Montana Fire Protection License Program business licenses and individual endorsements where exposed by the Licensee Lookup System
Montana Boiler Operator Program licenses where exposed by the Licensee Lookup System
knownExclusions: This source spans many professional and occupational programs and must be filtered to construction-relevant boards before normalization.
Construction Contractor Registration and Independent Contractor Exemption Certificate records are represented separately by us.mt.dli.contractor_registration.
Montana DEQ asbestos contractor and consultant publication is represented separately by us.mt.deq.asbestos_contractors.
Local permits, municipal contractor rules, business registrations, and non-DLI authorizations are outside this source entry.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Future work should review the official Licensee Lookup System and downloadable licensee mailing-list behavior before any opt-in network sync.
publicRecordsNotes: Official DLI licensee lookup metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that another license, contractor registration, local authorization, or related record does not exist.
officialLookupReviewNotes: DLI board pages identify the Licensee Lookup System as the primary source for verifying professional license credentials in Montana.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: DLI board pages state that licensee lists can be downloaded by license type from the Licensee Lookup System, but no adapter-reviewed stable construction-specific export contract has been implemented.
researchNotes: Registry-only blocked source for Montana professional and occupational construction-relevant boards. Future adapter work should split or filter electrical, plumbing, fire-protection, and boiler records explicitly before exposing normalized records.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Montana DLI professional and occupational board records only.
No matching record means no match in the checked source at the checked time, not proof that another board, contractor registration, local license, or related record does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while the official lookup/export contract and allowed reuse remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Do not treat broad Licensee Lookup System records as construction-specific until board filters and license-type mappings are fixture-tested.

researchEvidence.note: Official DLI lookup page reviewed; it identifies the Licensee Lookup System as the primary source for verifying Montana professional license credentials.
Official State Electrical Board page reviewed; it references electrical license lookup and downloadable licensee lists.
Official Board of Plumbers page reviewed; it identifies plumber licensing and the same Licensee Lookup System path.
Official Fire Protection License Program page reviewed; it identifies DLI licensing and public portal services for fire-protection licensees.
Official Boiler Operator Program page reviewed as a construction-adjacent mechanical credential path exposed through DLI professional licensing.

blocker.summary: The official lookup and mailing-list downloads are interactive and have no adapter-reviewed construction-specific export contract, privacy filter, or redistribution approval.
